t.eng-ummmuhammad: By those [angels] lined up in rows
And those who drive [the clouds]
And those who recite the message
Indeed, your God is One

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
ayahs.translit: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.translit: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

ayahs.arabic: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And as protection against every rebellious devil

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side
Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
ayahs.translit: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay
But you wonder, while they mock
And when they are reminded, they remember not
And when they see a sign, they ridicule

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And say, "This is not but obvious magic

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
And our forefathers [as well]
Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing

ayahs.translit: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny

ayahs.arabic: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

ayahs.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned
[They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other
But they, that Day, are in surrender
And they will approach one another blaming each other

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right
The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people

ayahs.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]
And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators
So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment
Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.translit: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet
Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do
But not the chosen servants of Allah
Those will have a provision determined
Fruits; and they will be honored
In gardens of pleasure
On thrones facing one another
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
White and delicious to the drinkers

ayahs.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
ayahs.translit: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes
As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.translit: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed
He will say, "Would you [care to] look
And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire
He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]
Then, are we not to die

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished
Indeed, this is the great attainment
For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work

ayahs.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.translit: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum
Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire
Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبࣰ ا مِّنۡ حَمِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water
Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire
Indeed they found their fathers astray
So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps
And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples
And We had already sent among them warners
Then look how was the end of those who were warned
But not the chosen servants of Allah
And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction
And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
Peace upon Noah among the worlds
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
Then We drowned the disbelievers
And indeed, among his kind was Abraham
When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire
Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds
And he cast a look at the stars
And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill
So they turned away from him, departing

ayahs.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat
What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak
And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand
Then the people came toward him, hastening
He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve
While Allah created you and that which you do

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.translit: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me
My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous
So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast
And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead
We called to him, "O Abraham

ayahs.arabic: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
Indeed, this was the clear trial
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
Peace upon Abraham
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

ayahs.arabic: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself
And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron
And We saved them and their people from the great affliction
And We supported them so it was they who overcame
And We gave them the explicit Scripture
And We guided them on the straight path
And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations
Peace upon Moses and Aaron
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
Indeed, they were of Our believing servants
And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers
When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah

ayahs.arabic: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators
Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]
Except the chosen servants of Allah
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
Peace upon Elias
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
And indeed, Lot was among the messengers
[So mention] when We saved him and his family, all
Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]
Then We destroyed the others
And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And at night. Then will you not use reason
And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers
[Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship
And he drew lots and was among the losers
Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy
And had he not been of those who exalt Allah

ayahs.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected
But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill
And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more
And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time
So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses
Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say
Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars
Has He chosen daughters over sons
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement
Then will you not be reminded
Or do you have a clear authority
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبࣰ اۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]
Exalted is Allah above what they describe
Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]
So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position
And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah
And indeed, the disbelievers used to say

ayahs.arabic: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples
We would have been the chosen servants of Allah
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know
And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers
[That] indeed, they would be those given victory
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome
So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time
And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see
Then for Our punishment are they impatient

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned
And leave them for a time
And see, for they are going to see

ayahs.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe
And peace upon the messengers
And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
